use_when: explicitly large phased or resumable work
multiple project areas or task profiles
expand_when: resolved semantic guidance bundle differs from the last accepted checkpoint
approval scope no longer covers applied changes
budget_behavior: keep ordered semantic guidance identities within route packet limits; load only active workstream context and its fact owners and dependencies, then only new or changed owners when bundle revalidation differs

semantic_guidance_revalidation.comparison_surface: current resolved ordered bundle digest versus last accepted checkpoint digest
semantic_guidance_revalidation.on_difference: stop the affected phase, record the identity delta, load only changed owners, refresh risk approval dependencies and validation, then checkpoint an accepted resolved bundle
semantic_guidance_revalidation.claim_boundary: bundle identity is not proof of model comprehension or compliance

final_evidence: planned resolved and observed semantic guidance identities and ordered bundle digests
